messages:
Riley P: Kicking off Helix Commerce POC perf run in 20m. Plan: smoke -> 180 qps sustained (25m) -> 2x 5m spikes at 720 qps. Customer target p99 < 250ms. @Diego L can you confirm reserved pool?
Diego L: Reserved pool ready (5xA10). Sustained 180qps ~65% reserved. Spikes will use burst; estimate +15-20% compute cost for spike windows.
Riley P: We'll test quantized-8bit and fp16. Record both. Keep routing pinned for baseline to measure raw behavior.
Anya K: Security asks noted: HSM keywrap flow, VPC peering window, and audit-log export. I'll prepare concise answers and redaction confirmation. No PHI in payloads.
QuoteBot: Sales: prepare two quote tracks: (A) reserved + perf tuning, (B) reserved + burst reservation + SLA credits.
Diego L: Note: default batch coalesce=10ms. For short prompts, coalesce=18ms reduces p99 in our sims. Also prefix cache priming helps tail under spike.
Riley P: Load command (vegeta pseudo): vegeta attack -rate=180 -duration=25m | vegeta report
Increase rate for spikes.
[~1.5h later]
Riley P: Run complete. Sustained 180 qps baseline (quantized): avg 130ms p95 200ms p99 420ms. Spikes: avg 380ms p95 790ms p99 1.4s. fp16 baseline p99 ~330ms. Cache misses drove many tail results.
Diego L: Root cause: cache eviction + batching queue depth during spikes. Mitigations: prefix priming + coalesce=18ms drops p99 to ~260ms in our emulation. Cost impact modest (~+10%).
Anya K: Security deliverables ETA EOD: HSM diagram, KMS flow, audit retention options. Flagging EU-only residency ask as potential blocker for hosted POC.
Riley P: Action items: 1) rerun tomorrow with coalesce=18ms + prefix primed, 2) include latency histogram and CSV for sales deck, 3) produce two quote variants and a short note on fallback behavior.
QuoteBot: Noted. Draft quotes will include cost delta for burst reservation and a fallback-quality note.
Riley P: Thanks team — I'll assemble the customer-facing summary after the retest. :white_check_mark:
